🌿 About Sprout

Growing calm, confidence
& potential — together

A little about the person behind the practice, and the values that guide every session.

Lauren Burns

BSc Psychology  ·  Diploma in Hypno CBT (UKCHH)  ·  Nottingham

I'm Lauren — a qualified therapist with a genuine passion for supporting teenagers through some of life's most challenging moments. I know how overwhelming adolescence can feel, and I believe that with the right tools and the right space, every young person can find their calm and step into their confidence.

I hold a degree in Psychology and a Diploma in Hypno CBT from the UK College of Hypnosis and Hypnotherapy. Before training as a therapist, I spent 20 years as a teacher — which means I genuinely understand how young people think, communicate, and learn. That experience shapes everything I do at Sprout.

At Sprout, I combine evidence-based Cognitive Behavioural Therapy with therapeutic hypnosis — a clinically informed approach that uses focused relaxation to help teenagers engage more deeply with the change process. My sessions are warm, conversational, and always tailored to the individual.

Whether your teenager is struggling with anxiety, low self-esteem, exam stress, or just feeling a little lost — I'm here to help them grow.

🌿 What we offer

CBT with Hypnosis
for Teenagers

A powerful, gentle combination that helps young people reframe their thinking and feel genuinely different.

Cognitive Behavioural Therapy with Hypnosis

A bespoke programme for teenagers — delivered with warmth and expertise

Sprout's signature approach pairs the well-established structure of Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) with therapeutic hypnosis — two complementary modalities that together create deep, meaningful change. CBT helps teenagers identify and shift unhelpful patterns of thinking and behaviour. Hypnosis deepens this work by promoting a state of focused relaxation, making it easier to engage with and embed the changes explored in therapy.

What sessions include

🗣️

Open, guided conversations to explore thoughts, feelings, and patterns.

🛠️

CBT Techniques

Practical tools and exercises to challenge and reshape unhelpful thinking.

💫

Therapeutic Hypnosis

Gentle, guided relaxation to support focus and receptiveness to change.

📚

🎯

Clear, teen-friendly goals to give direction and celebrate progress.

👩‍👧

Optional, appropriate updates to keep parents informed and involved.

💭

A note on hypnosis

Therapeutic hypnosis is nothing like stage hypnosis — it's a safe, evidence-informed technique that uses guided relaxation and focused attention to help people respond more readily to therapeutic suggestions. You are always in control, always aware, and always able to end the session. For teenagers, it can be a highly effective complement to CBT, supporting anxiety reduction, confidence building, and positive behaviour change.

❓ Questions

Frequently asked questions

How many sessions will my teenager need?

This varies depending on the individual and their goals. Some young people notice real change in 4–6 sessions; others prefer a longer programme. We'll discuss this together in the initial consultation and review progress as we go.

Is hypnosis safe for teenagers?

Yes — therapeutic hypnosis is a gentle, completely safe technique that teenagers often respond to very well. It's simply a state of focused relaxation. Your teen will always be in control and fully aware throughout.

Do sessions take place in person or online?

Please get in touch to discuss what works best for you. Options can vary — contact Lauren directly for the most up-to-date information on session delivery.

How do I get started?

Simply get in touch via phone or email for a friendly, no-obligation chat. Lauren will be happy to talk you through everything and answer any questions you have before booking.
